description.en: The name of the data catalog.
The region where the data lake resides.

description.zh: 被更新表的名称。若无需更新表名，则与TableInput的Name保持一致即可。
description.en: The name of the updated table. If you do not need to update the table name, set the TableName and TableInput parameters to the same value.

description.zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the tenant.

>  To view the ID of the tenant, go to the DMS console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~) section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic.
